storyTitle: SBI's Q2 FY27 standalone profit rises 14.3% to ₹23,038 crore, helped by a mutual-fund stake sale
insight: SBI's 14% profit jump leans on a one-off stake sale; core operating profit grew just 7.3%, so read earnings for what repeats.
linkedin:
Strip out one stake sale and SBI's 14% profit jump shrinks to 7%.

SBI's Q2 profit rose 14.3% to ₹23,038 crore, but about ₹7,288 crore came from selling a 6.3% stake in SBI Funds Management.

Core operating profit grew just 7.3% to ₹34,226 crore, so the headline flatters the engine underneath.

Read earnings season for what repeats, not what's booked once.

leaders.title: "Trust Is a Must": How Meta Built Muse by Launching Late
leaders.post:
Meta spent seven months on Muse while rivals shipped in two.

Mona Sarantakos, head of product for Muse, says that was deliberate: "Trust is a must," because an agent holding your email and able to buy things can't launch with open issues.

Her team built its own safety evals, a "sentinel" backstop outside the core agent, and a handwritten system prompt.
